subject: Geography
role: The SAG is the IEB counterpart of the DBE's Grade 12 Examination Guidelines plus the ATP's programme-of-assessment prescriptions in one document: per subject it fixes the NSC examination structure (papers, marks, durations, cognitive-level spread) and the Grades 10-12 school-based assessment requirements for IEB schools.
edition_model: SAGs are reissued per examination year. The edition current when this index was authored targets the 2026 examination year (the Mathematics SAG's 2026 edition was updated August 2025); always take the newest edition for the exam year being taught.

documents.title: Geography - IEB Subject Assessment Guidelines, 2026 examination year
documents.url_note: Per-document download URLs on ieb.co.za sit behind a bot-blocking front end and could not be captured in this environment; fill in via a browser session on the portal page, then run ieb_sources.py verify.

ingestion.method: Mirror the CAPS exam_guidelines ingestion: full decoded text as .md with page markers, plus a structured .json carrying document metadata and the exam_structure (papers, marks, durations, section weights) exactly as printed in the SAG. No numbers may be transcribed from third-party re-uploads (Studocu/Scribd) - only from the fetched official PDF.
